comment: Burrows design document (Fallout 1, cut): talking raccoons who fled the Glow (FSEF/West Tek) set up a lush jungle oasis on a river, far from any bomb site, known as the 'Animal Men' near the radiation crater down south. Position computed from The Glow anchor (33.1674, -116.7911): ~20 mi downstream on the San Luis Rey River (which leaves Lake Henshaw beside the Glow) near Pala, CA. Not the Fallout 76 Burrows in West Virginia; canon: no (only a Glow holodisk alludes to the escaped animals)
